text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PAGER fired for service=metering-billing-queue (INC12345). Priority=P1. Symptoms: ingestion lag >12m, unprocessed batches accumulating, token count skew detected. PD link: https://pd.internal/INC12345

pd-bot: Incident INC12345 created and assigned to oncall @maya (sre-oncall). Auto-escalation in 15m if not acknowledged.

maya: acked. I'm on it. Joining bridge in ~2m :phone:. Any initial customer impact notes?

owen: I'm seeing backlog ~1.2M messages in billing queue, consumer lag ~13m. Kafka consumer group 'billing-aggregator' shows stalled offsets for partition 7. No recent pod restarts reported yet.

jessica: autoscaler note: no new pods launched because avg CPU ~7% — that smells like consumers stuck on IO or checkpoint. Pulling recent logs now.

maya: runbook link? can we get quick commands to inspect?

jessica: try: ```kubectl -n metering get pods -l app=billing-aggregator``` ```kubectl -n metering logs -l app=billing-aggregator --tail=200```

owen: logs (excerpt): ```2026-03-14T12:00:21Z ERROR CheckpointCommitter - commit failed: 409 Conflict: Commit failed for partition=7, offset=1423456``` ```2026-03-14T12:02:05Z WARN ConsumerLoop - Offset out of range for partition 7, resetting to earliest```

adrian: that pattern matches previous checkpoint-corruption incidents. Recommend pausing ingestion for the affected topic, run checkpoint-repair per runbook: https://internal/runbooks/metering-checkpoint-repair.

maya: pausing new ingest accepted risk. Finance impact: if we delay processing, invoices for today's window might be incomplete. Paging finance ops: @finance-team please standby. We should set invoice_hold flag until counts verified.

finance-bot: Received invoice hold request for 2026-03-14 batches. Acknowledged and queued.

jessica: I can do a rolling restart of billing-aggregator pods (one at a time) to try to free stuck consumers. Will coordinate to avoid mass rebalancing. Command: ```kubectl -n metering rollout restart deployment/billing-aggregator --field-selector metadata.name=pod-3```

owen: restarted pod-3. Consumer resumed and processed ~400k messages, backlog dropped to ~800k, but partition 7 still showing stuck offset.

maya: tentative plan: 1) escalate to L2 (adrian) 2) run checkpoint_repair job on partition 7 3) start controlled backfill to catch up 4) hold invoices until counts verified. objections?

adrian: supporting. I'll start checkpoint_repair now. ETA ~18m. I'll monitor for any duplicate processing risk. :warning:

jessica: adding temporary route to fallback aggregator in us-west to relieve pressure on primary cluster. Will monitor latency.

pd-bot: INC12345 acknowledged by maya at 2060043225. Escalation to L2 triggered at 2060043300 if unresolved.

maya: customer impact summary: ~2k customers may experience delayed billing notifications. No evidence of incorrect charges yet, but token counts reported to billing may undercount until backfill completes. Notifying CSMs and Trust. :email:

owen: checkpoint_repair logs: ```INFO checkpoint_repair - Rewound offsets for partition 7 by 12,480 messages; committed new safe-offset=1,420,000``` Backfill job started, initial throughput ~18k/s.

maya: starting incident bridge notes and timeline. Samir (next oncall) — you're up in ~30m; I'll brief you and hand off if still open.

samir: acked. Will join bridge and take over if incident persists.

maya: thanks all. Once backfill reaches <5m lag and we validate token counts against the reconciliation job, we'll lift invoice_hold and close PD. I'll add follow-up tasks for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
